full_details: The City has been quiet three days. From first light you wrote Pomfret, the king alone, and how a prison may be a world. Then music, a groom, the men who come to kill him, and he dies fighting, which you had not known he would. The coffin goes to the cousin. A little before ten the last couplet went down, and you ruled a line under it. It is sixty-odd days since Gaunt's four words. Gib was on the Holinshed, and you let him lie. In the account book you wrote that the king ended this day and is not yet shown. You did not open the coffer. At breakfast Mistress Ansell had a dish in her hands and asked if it was the lovers. You said no, and you did not tell her the play. There is no fool in it. You will tell him after Midsummer, and you did not tell him today. At two you played in Errors. At the reckoning nobody named a sum.
one_sentence: You finished the king before ten, left the cat on the chronicle, and at two you played in Errors.
title: Ruled a line under the king
